english.title: Fail to give name / address to an authorised person after requirement to pay / being liable to pay a penalty fare
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[was travelling]_
(B)_[had travelled]_

on a

(C)_[bus]_

service at, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SERVICE..), within the Greater London Authority area at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) and not being able to produce a valid fare ticket or a general travel authority, failed to provide your name and address when required to do so to an authorised person as provided by paragraph 7(1) of Schedule 17 to the Greater London Authority Act
